name: needlewhile
description: A warm yarn-ball waiting toy that runs while Codex works.

interface.shortDescription: A tactile yarn-ball toy for the time between prompt and answer.
interface.longDescription: Needlewhile opens a bright full-screen yarn-ball toy while Codex is working. Click or press a key to sink long illustrated needles into a floating teal yarn ball with a dry, procedural wool rustle; the toy freezes when the turn ends.
defaultPrompt: Check whether the Needlewhile companion is running.
